definitions.explanation: An airline route or flight that crosses national borders. Also refers to the part of an airport that handles such flights, with customs and immigration facilities.

examples.japanese: {国際線|こくさいせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧⟦ターミナル→ターミナル：11037_taaminaru⟧です。
⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧{国際線|こくさいせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: I'm flying internationally for the first time.

examples.japanese: {国際線|こくさいせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{二|に}{時間|じかん}→二時間：27637_nijikan⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: For international flights you need to arrive at the airport two hours before departure.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧ (international) + ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line; route). Most commonly heard in airline and airport announcements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国際線|こくさいせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to take an international flight
- {国際線|こくさいせん}⟦ターミナル→ターミナル：11037_taaminaru⟧: international terminal
- {国際線|こくさいせん}⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}ロビー→出発ロビー：26118_shuppatsurobii⟧: international departure lobby
- {国際線|こくさいせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乗|の}り{継|つ}ぎ→乗り継ぎ：09926_noritsugi⟧: international connecting flight

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{国内線|こくないせん}→国内線：27501_kokunaisen⟧: domestic flight — the within-country counterpart
- {国際便|こくさいびん}: international flight — refers to a specific flight rather than the route
- {海外便|かいがいびん}: overseas flight — colloquial alternative
